text:
Jules Carter: Quick thread to finalize the internal release note for tiny-slate v2026.06.1. Canary at 13:40 PT, broad rollout 14:10 PT. Draft: https://redwood.internal/rn/drafts/2026-06-1
Iman Rafiq (Ops): Need exact pin + commit SHA for routing and the rollback matrix. Also ops wants a short bulleted checklist in the runbook.
Jules Carter: Pin we'll use: model_bundle=rbw-slate-0601, commit=de4b8f1, runtime=snap-192. I'll add a pinned_at timestamp before publishing.
Lee Morgan (Perf): Add a mixed-length canary (70% short, 30% long). From load tests, tail latency could rise on long sequences. Rollback triggers suggestion: p50>430ms, error_rate+0.8%, any OOM.
Avery Stone (Oncall): I'm oncall for the window (13:00-16:00 PT). I'll run the checklist and own the rollback decision if triggers fire.
Iman Rafiq: Fallback model: rbw-slate-0522. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/RBW-SLATE-ROLLBACK-0601. I'll append the ops checklist there: preflight queries, KV cache prewarm, autoscaler sanity check, smoke prompts.
DocsOps Bot: Keep the blast concise: one-line header with times + one bullet for what to watch. I'll post preview after a final blurb.
Jules Carter: Draft blurb for DocsOps Bot:
"Internal: Deploy v2026.06.1 — Canary 13:40 PT, Rollout 14:10 PT. Model pinned to rbw-slate-0601 (commit de4b8f1). Rollback if p50>430ms, error rate increases >0.8% or any OOM. Fallback: rbw-slate-0522. Oncall: Avery Stone. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/RBW-SLATE-ROLLBACK-0601."
Iman Rafiq: LGTM. Please include the exact pin block in the draft for infra: `model_bundle: rbw-slate-0601`, `commit: de4b8f1`, `runtime: snap-192`, `pinned_at: 2026-06-01T12:50:00Z`.
Lee Morgan: Also add a short regression prompt set to the release note so SRE knows which checks to run: short-10, mid-5, long-3.
DocsOps Bot: Preview posted: https://redwood.internal/rn/previews/2026-06-1 — commenting with an oncall callout. Will publish internal blast at 13:20 PT unless there are edits. :sparkles:
Avery Stone: I'll run the runbook checklist at 13:20 PT and report status. Standing by for the 13:25 final blurb.
Jules Carter: Final blurb pushed to draft and pinned the model. Pinned metadata added to draft.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary scheduled: staging -> prod-canary at 2026-06-01T13:40:00-07:00 (requested by Jules Carter). Reminder set for 15 minutes prior.
Iman Rafiq: Ops checklist done at 13:25 PT: KV cache prewarm completed, autoscaler sanity OK, preflight queries passed. No OOMs in staging.
DocsOps Bot: Internal blast published at 13:20 PT. Included oncall rota and runbook link.
Avery Stone: Canary started. Running mixed-length sample now.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Reminder: Canary starts in 5 minutes (2026-06-01T13:35:00-07:00).
Avery Stone: Canary complete: PASS. Metrics snapshot: p50=305ms, error_rate_delta=0.15%, kv_miss=1.2%. No rollback triggered. Posting final release note here for record.
Jules Carter: Thanks team  updating the release tracker and closing thread. :white_check_mark:
